Vijay Deverakonda's Team Denies 'Luxury Demands' Reports on 'Ranabaali' Set

Reports emerged alleging that actor Vijay Deverakonda made "luxury demands" and incurred "insane entourage costs" during the shoot of his film 'Ranabaali'. However, Deverakonda's team has publicly refuted these claims. They described the reports as "fabricated," aiming to clarify the situation surrounding the actor's conduct on set. This incident follows similar scrutiny faced by another actor, Ranveer Singh, regarding entourage expenses.
